scenes.basis: Prologue; "the voice of one crying in the wilderness" (v3) is a quotation
1:4 "John came baptizing in the wilderness"; 1:5 "All the country of Judea... went out to him"
1:9 "Jesus came from Nazareth of Galilee, and was baptized by John in the Jordan"
1:12 "Immediately the Spirit drove him out into the wilderness"
1:14 "Jesus came into Galilee, preaching the Good News of God's Kingdom"
1:16 "Passing along by the sea of Galilee, he saw Simon and Andrew"
1:21 "They went into Capernaum, and immediately on the Sabbath day he entered into the synagogue and taught"
1:29 "they came into the house of Simon and Andrew" - in Capernaum (1:21), no movement out of the town
1:35 "he rose up and went out, and departed into a deserted place, and prayed there" - the place is unnamed
1:39 "He went into their synagogues throughout all Galilee"
1:40-45 the leper is healed on this Galilee preaching circuit; 1:45 "he was outside in desert places" - no town named
